fact: Farsight's press release says the LRA launched ITAS on 19 April 2023 for digital registration, online filing and payment, and that over 8,500 taxpayers were already registered in the pilot.
The Analyst reports the LRA officially launched LITAS, with online registration and filing, on 19 April 2023 after a pilot from 2021, with rollout to all tax offices in the 15 counties to follow.
